title: Source-class sweep 2: off-block / pushback timestamps at LFPG, LTFM, LIRF (priority) and EGLL, LEBL, LEMD, EDDF
rules: public pages only, sequential, no account, no credential, no form, no contact, no bulk download
result: No usable source: nothing passes open licence + per-departure ground timestamp + 2025 + January / July 2026

sources.source: LiveATC.net recorded frequencies
sources.holds: Recorded ground/delivery/tower audio; a pushback or start-up clearance is a per-flight event (seconds, after speech recognition)
sources.airports: None at LFPG, LIRF, EGLL, LEBL, LEMD (rebroadcasting not allowed in France, UK, Spain; no public LIRF feed as of Aug 2025); LTFM and EDDF not confirmed
sources.cov_2025: Archive retention of 4-5 years claimed; no feed at the target airports
sources.licence: None open. Quotes: 'the sale of audio data'; 'There are countries such as the UK, Spain, and France that don't allow third-party rebroadcasting of ATC frequencies'
sources.why: No open licence (audio sold commercially); no feed at the priority airports; a clearance is ATC-side, not the airport record

sources.source: ATCO2 and LiveATC-derived sets on Hugging Face
sources.holds: Transcribed ATC speech
sources.why: Wrong years and airports; licences missing

sources.source: Air France-KLM 'Open Data' Flight Status API (same class: Lufthansa, Turkish Airlines developer APIs)
sources.holds: Scheduled / estimated / actual times of the airline's own flights
sources.airports: Hub carrier at LFPG (AF) and EHAM (KL); others per airline
sources.licence: None stated; 'accessible following registration'; API key required
sources.why: Registration, no open licence, no documented history back to 2025

sources.source: Wayback Machine captures of parisaeroport.fr, istairport.com, adr.it departure pages
sources.holds: Snapshots of departure-board pages
sources.cov_2026: IST 6 (Jan) / 2 (Jul); CDG 2 (Jul); ADR queries time out
sources.licence: No licence (third-party copyright; the Internet Archive grants none)
sources.why: The captured CDG page (18 Jul 2026) holds no flight number or time: the board loads from an API at runtime; no licence

sources.source: GitHub repository search (scrapers / archives of CDG, FCO, IST, LHR boards)
sources.holds: Nothing relevant: two Heathrow scrapers (2009, 2017), live-API chat apps for IST
sources.why: No archive exists; scraped boards would inherit the airport's copyright anyway

sources.source: Hugging Face datasets (incl. 345rf4gt56t4r3e3/flight-delays-europe-2023-2025)
sources.holds: 15.3 M European flights with dof, first_seen, last_seen, adep, ades, delay_min (OPDI flight-list fields); ADS-B sets are adsb.lol mirrors or gated
sources.licence: Tag 'apache-2.0' on a re-upload of OPDI-derived fields
sources.why: No off-block time (first_seen is the OPDI sighting, already covered); no 2026

sources.source: Zenodo (taxi-out, off-block, pushback, A-CDM, TOBT, surface movement, the three airports)
sources.holds: Istanbul triple-runway CO2 dataset (no files exposed); global hourly ADS-B aggregate; older OpenSky / Nantes / Gatwick sets
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 on the records found
sources.why: No per-departure ground event at the ten airports

sources.source: Figshare, Dryad, Mendeley Data
sources.holds: Nothing relevant
sources.why: Nothing found

sources.source: Amelia-48, TartanAviation
sources.holds: Surface tracks (FAA SWIM), ATC speech, images
sources.why: Wrong region

sources.source: Bruitparif (SURVOL network around CDG; open noise maps)
sources.holds: Overflight noise events at stations under flight paths; the open datasets are Ln / Lden maps
sources.licence: Maps: Licence Ouverte 2.0 ('lov2'); event exports: terms not readable (JavaScript viewer)
sources.why: Measures airborne flyovers after take-off (take-off time is already supplied); no ground or off-block signal

sources.source: Aeroporti di Roma noise system (radar-correlated)
sources.holds: Annual reporting; no data on the page
sources.why: No public data, no licence

sources.source: Istanbul Airport (IGA / DHMI) noise
sources.holds: EIA chapter only
sources.why: No monitoring data published

sources.source: Frankfurt INAA (Umwelthaus) and City of Frankfurt analyses
sources.holds: Viewer of DFS tracks and noise; monthly PDFs
sources.why: Viewer and aggregates, airborne, no licence (Heathrow / Aena WebTrak were covered earlier)

sources.source: A-CDM milestone data (TOBT / TSAT / AOBT) from research projects
sources.holds: Papers using non-public samples (e.g. one week at Schiphol); ENAV FCO A-CDM leaflet (2014)
sources.why: No published A-CDM dataset for any of the ten airports

sources.source: COHOR (France); same class: ACL, Assoclearance
sources.holds: Start-of-season slot statistics
sources.why: Aggregates

sources.source: data.europa.eu (all EU national portals), datos.gob.es, GovData.de, data.gouv.fr, ENAIRE, ENAC / ENAV, DHMI
sources.holds: Monthly airport / airline totals (e.g. Barcelona City Council monthly operations by airline, CC BY 4.0), noise maps, AIP data sets
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 / dl-by-de 2.0 / Licence Ouverte on the aggregates
sources.why: No per-flight or per-hour ground record in any catalogue

sources.source: Historical NOTAMs (stand / apron / taxiway closures)
sources.holds: Current NOTAMs; paid APIs; EAD needs an account
sources.why: No open history, and NOTAMs carry closures, not off-block times

sources.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 (and commercial daily constellations)
sources.holds: 10 m images; aircraft at stands visible at one instant
sources.licence: 'free, full and open access' (Copernicus legal notice); commercial imagery not open
sources.why: One instant every few days cannot time a pushback

sources.source: nyuuzyou/airportwebcams index (and the feeds it lists)
sources.holds: 2,508 webcam URLs; no images, no timestamps
sources.licence: Index CC0; the feeds keep their owners' terms
sources.why: Feeds are not archived or openly licensed; a camera sees a few stands

sources.source: OpenStreetMap public GPS traces (trackpoints API) at the aprons
sources.holds: Timestamped phone / GPS traces, some from passengers in taxiing aircraft
sources.cov_2025: LTFM 1 taxi-like trace (13 Jul 2025); LFPG / LIRF none in Jan / Jul
sources.cov_2026: LTFM 1 short trace (28 Jul 2026); LFPG / LIRF none in Jan / Jul
sources.licence: Not stated for traces (ODbL covers the map database)
sources.why: At most one or two departures per airport-month; trace licence unclear

sources.source: Climate TRACE (also EU ETS, CORSIA reports)
sources.holds: Monthly emissions per airport source
sources.why: Monthly aggregates modelled from traffic; no per-flight time

sources.source: PRC Data Challenge 2026 data page and team pages
sources.holds: The same three files; the team page read lists no external source
sources.why: No new data release

considered_not_checked_online: Seismic / infrasound citizen networks (e.g. Raspberry Shake): no station known within hearing of a stand; cannot identify a flight. Not checked online.
Citizen noise sensors (Sensor.Community DNMS): minute LAeq in towns, cannot see a pushback. Not checked online.
Photo archives with CC licences (Wikimedia Commons, Flickr): a few pushback photos a year, EXIF times unreliable. Not checked online.
Ground-vehicle transponders (tugs broadcasting ADS-B): heard by the same receivers as aircraft, so dark where aircraft are dark. Belongs to the covered ADS-B class.
SATCOM / HFDL ACARS: HFDL is already in the adsb.lol archive scanned by oooi_ext; satellite ACARS is only in airframes.io (not open).
OpenSky REST API flights endpoint: covered with OpenSky (docs/opensky/README.md); account terms are not an open licence.
Airport A-CDM manuals / AIP AD 2.20 describing how AOBT is captured per stand type: documentation, not per-flight data; stand-level biases were already closed (docs/dig/README.md).
receipts: receipts/ (licence_excerpts.txt and one search log per catalogue)
